name: Oscar Molina
intro: I’m Oscar, a student working in photography, graphic design, and CAD. I also design and machine parts with FIRST Robotics Team 3950.
bio: I’m a high school student working across photography, video, graphic design, and fabrication. My experience includes robotics, event photography, and stage crew.

skills.title: Photography & video
skills.description: Photography, videography, video editing, and color grading.

skills.title: Graphic design
skills.description: Posters, shirts, stickers, business cards, and visual identity.

skills.title: CAD & fabrication
skills.description: 3D design, CNC machining, lathe and mill operation, and 3D printing.

skills.title: Collaboration
skills.description: Teaching new teammates, organizing work, and learning by doing. Spanish conversation, reading, and writing at an upper B2 level.

experience.title: FIRST Robotics Team 3950
experience.description: Designed and machined parts for two robots over two years, and helped new members learn mechanical design and safe machinery use. Created recruitment and competition posters and photographed team events, demos, and Robo Camp.

experience.title: Stage & sound crew
experience.description: Built sets and handled on-stage set changes for seven plays and musicals. Managed the sound system, actor microphones, and sound cues for one play.

experience.title: Scouts of America
experience.description: Four years with Troop 195, with merit badges in areas including first aid, cooking, graphic arts, emergency preparedness, and entrepreneurship.

projects.title: Arts Angels
projects.description: A website for Arts Angels at North Shore, featuring events, membership information, and ways to support fine and performing arts across the school district.

projects.title: Stillnote
projects.description: A local-first desktop workspace for macOS and Windows. Stillnote brings Markdown notes, visual canvases, spreadsheets, Gantt charts, and linked files into one app, with optional AI assistance and Google Tasks integration. Your work stays in folders you control.

details.title: Notes that stay yours
details.description: Open a folder as a vault and write in ordinary Markdown files. The editor renders formatting as you work, saves changes automatically, and links notes to files, headings, or exact lines. Your notes remain readable outside Stillnote.

details.title: More than a text editor
details.description: Arrange text and images on visual canvases, calculate in spreadsheets, and plan work with Gantt charts. Bring graphs, geometry, 3D models, PDFs, and media into the same workspace, with linked previews inside notes.

details.title: Optional connections
details.description: Sync task sheets with Google Tasks and explore math with Desmos. Connect your own AI provider to ask about notes and linked files or request edits. AI sends relevant content to the selected provider when used; file storage stays local.

details.title: Built for the desktop
details.description: Built with Electron, JavaScript, Vite, and CodeMirror 6, with Three.js for 3D views. The project includes macOS and Windows installers, GitHub Actions release workflows, and a companion website with an interactive app demo, documentation, and changelog.
